name: ForceDelegateApproval
description: Emergency override: forces a delegation on behalf of another user. Requires Admin role.

delegatorUser.description: SAP User ID of the manager whose rights are being delegated.

delegateUser.description: SAP User ID of the employee receiving the delegation.

validFrom.description: Start date of delegation in YYYY-MM-DD format.

validTo.description: End date of delegation in YYYY-MM-DD format.

maxAmount.description: Optional maximum order amount limit (e.g. 500000). If the user specifies a limit like 'dưới 50 triệu' or 'hạn mức 500000', extract it here as a number.
